svg.title: K20 · The limit nobody wrote: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 20: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service showdown (one stable address); Pod showdown (Cats vs Dogs, no limits written). Also: LimitRange (set by the platform, team, per namespace). Your mission: Nobody set a memory limit. Why was it killed?
